Docusign Envelope ID: 6EC7F4E1-A44C-4689-B19A-308915AB31FC

  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  DECEMBER 10, 2024

  A regular meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Brock at 5:37 p.m., on
  Tuesday, December 10, 2024 , at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Phil Brock
  Mayor Pro Tem Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre
  Councilmember Christine Parra
  Councilmember Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick (Arrived at 5:57 p.m.)

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  City Clerk Nikima S. Newsome

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:37 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmember Zwick. Mayor Pro Tem Negrete led
  the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  GENERAL PUBLIC  Members of the public Assemblymember Rick Zbur, Mayor John Erickson,
  INPUT AND PUBLIC  Vice Mayor Chelsea Byers, Nick Faires, Zac Gaidzik, Joey Apodaca,
  INPUT FOR SPECIAL  Councilmembers Bubba Fish and Yasmine-Imani McMorrin, Jerry Rubin,
  AGENDA ITEMS ONLY:  Judith Serlin, John Medlin, Kathryn Boole, David Whatley, Danielle Wilson,
  Joleigh Sherwood, Denise Barton, Wade Kelley, Janet McLaughlin, Julie
  (Councilmember Zwick  Taren, John C. Smith, Jon Katz, Kaleigh Malloy, and Robert Hooks
  arrived at 5:57 p.m.)  commented on various local issues and Special Agenda Items.

  SPECIAL AGENDA  3.A. Recognition of Outgoing Councilmembers Brock, Davis, de la
  ITEMS:  Torre, and Parra, was presented by Mayor Pro Tem Negrete.
  OUTGOING
  COUNCILMEMBERS

  OFFICIAL CANVASS  3.B. Adoption of Resolution Accepting the Official Canvass and
  Official Statement of Votes Cast for the Consolidated General
  Municipal Election Held on November 5, 2024, and Declaring the
  Results Thereof, was presented.

  1  December 10, 2024
 Docusign Envelope ID: 6EC7F4E1-A44C-4689-B19A-308915AB31FC

  Recommended Action
  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt the resolution accepting the
  Official Canvass for the General Municipal Election held on November 5,
  2024.

  Motion by Councilmember Davis, seconded by Councilmember Torosis, to
  adopt the staff recommendation. The motion was approved by the
  following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers de la Torre, Torosis, Davis, Parra, Zwick
  Mayor Pro Tem Negrete, Mayor Brock
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  ADJOURNMENT OF THE  On order of the Mayor, City Council, as presently constituted, was
  CURRENT COUNCIL  adjourned and the meeting was turned over to the City Clerk Nikima S.
  Newsome.

  INSTALLATION OF NEW OFFICERS

  SANTA MONICA  3.C. Administration of Oath of Office to New Santa Monica Malibu
  MALIBU UNIFIED  Unified School District Board Members, was presented.
  SCHOOL DISTRICT
  BOARD  City Clerk Newsome administered the oath of office to newly elected Santa
  Monica Malibu Unified School District Board Members Jennifer Smith,
  Jon Kean and Maria Leon-Vazquez.

  RENT CONTROL BOARD  3.D. Administration of Oath of Office to New Santa Monica Rent
  Control Board Members, was presented.

  City Clerk Newsome administered the oath of office to newly elected Santa
  Monica Rent Control Board Members Kay Ambriz and Phillis Dudick.

  CITY COUNCIL  3.E. Administration of Oath of Office to New Santa Monica City
  Council Members, was presented.

  City Clerk Newsome administered the oath of office to newly elected
  Councilmembers Dan Hall, Ellis Raskin, Barry Snell and Natalya
  Zernitskaya.

  CONVENING OF THE  3.F.  Convening of new City Council, was presented.
  NEW CITY COUNCIL
  AND ELECTION OF  Roll Call
  MAYOR AND MAYOR
  PRO TEMPORE  PRESENT: Councilmembers Hall, Negrete, Raskin, Snell, Torosis,

  2  December 10, 2024
 Docusign Envelope ID: 6EC7F4E1-A44C-4689-B19A-308915AB31FC

  Zernitskaya, and Zwick.

  Election of Mayor for the ensuing year, was presented.
  The City Clerk opened the floor for nominations for electing of Mayor for
  the ensuing year.

  Motion by Councilmember Torosis, seconded by Councilmember Snell, to
  appoint Councilmember Negrete as Mayor for the ensuing year. The
  motion was approved by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Hall, Negrete, Raskin, Snell, Torosis,
  Zernitskaya, Zwick,
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  Election of Mayor Pro Tem for the ensuing two years, was presented.

  Mayor Negrete opened the floor for nominations for electing of Mayor Pro
  Tem for the ensuing two years.

  Motion by Councilmember Hall, seconded by Councilmember Raskin, to
  appoint Councilmember Torosis as Mayor Pro Tem for the first year and
  Councilmember Zwick for the second year. The motion was approved by
  the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Hall, Negrete, Raskin, Snell, Torosis,
  Zernitskaya, Zwick,
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  END OF INSTALLATION OF NEW OFFICERS

  3  December 10, 2024
 Docusign Envelope ID: 6EC7F4E1-A44C-4689-B19A-308915AB31FC

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 8:02 p.m. in
  memory of Chris Purcell and Joyce Borinstein Steers.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Nikima S. Newsome  Phil Brock
  City Clerk  Mayor

  APPROVED:

  Lana Negrete
  Mayor

  4  December 10, 2024
